description: ED-318 UASZone feature collections (EUROCAE ED-318, spec 02 F1-F3, 04 sections 3.4 and 4): parse and validate on receipt, never repair (06 T9); export equal by value; the ED-269 mapping both ways with what each side cannot hold refused by name; applicability with daylight events (BMCT, SR, SS, EECT) resolved per day, an unresolvable event reported as not evaluated.
source: EUROCAE ED-318 JSON schema, github.com/UASGeoZones/ED-318 schema/ at e98b292c5665a04989d62e32fd93829f161a89a9
Regulation (EU) 2021/664 Art. 3(4) (the U-space airspace requirements block)
spec 02 F1, F2; 03 geo_zones; 04 sections 3.4 and 4; 09 section 1.6

units.extent radius: metres (unverified against the ED-318 text; the schema gives no unit)
units.layer upper, lower: the layer's uom: m (default) or ft

tolerance.export: equal by value (JSON values; member order free)
tolerance.must_include: field ends with field_endswith and the reason contains reason_contains

cases.name: map-ed269-zone-to-ed318
cases.why: ED-269 to ED-318 (spec 02 F1): restriction REQ_AUTHORISATION becomes type REQ_AUTHORIZATION, type becomes variant, applicability becomes limitedApplicability, texts become one-language lists, FT stays the layer's ft and the circle radius becomes metres (1640 ft = 499.872 m, exactly with 0.3048). The ED-269 fields ED-318 has no member for (uSpaceClass, a list of restrictionConditions) and the radius as published in feet travel in extendedProperties.ed269 and return to ED-269 unchanged; the ED-318 radius is always metres (owner decision on PR #16).
